box.highlights: East Islip 43, Kings Park 9: Thomas Costarelli completed 3 of 4 passes for 84 yards and a touchdown and rushed for 44 yards and a touchdown to lead East Islip in its Suffolk III opener. Ryan Parker added 29 rushing yards and two touchdowns on six carries and Jake Simmons rushed for 43 yards and a touchdown on six carries. Andrew Cooper's game-opening 86-yard kick return set up Parker's first touchdown. Matt Mcintee had two catches for 73 yards and a touchdown. Sebastian Regis posted four tackles for loss. Aidan Barbosa rushed for 79 yards and a touchdown on nine carries for Kings Park.

Sayville 40, Kings Park 28: Jake Tripptree completed 13-of-19 passes for 233 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 65 yards and a touchdown to lead Sayville (1-0) in Suffolk III. Dan Holahan rushed for 89 yards and a touchdown on nine carries, and Kyle Messina rushed for 39 yards, a touchdown and grabbed three interceptions. Luke Hansen caught two touchdowns, Mike Sands had two sacks and returned an interception for a touchdown and Landon Garrett added two sacks. Kyle Weeks threw for 191 yards and three touchdowns, and Brandon Hauk caught 106 yards and three touchdowns for Kings Park (0-2).

Kings Park 27, Eastport-South Manor 6: John Flynn carried eight times for 147 yards, including an 87-yard touchdown, to lead Kings Park (1-2). Quarterback Kyle Weeks ran nine times for 82 yards and two touchdowns and went 7-for-9 passing for 84 yards and a score. Weeks also made 11 tackles at free safety. Brandon Hauk, who made three receptions for 70 yards, and Dean Renna each had 13 tackles. Giuseppe Buffolino and Tommy Bailes each had a sack, and Tommy Cassar made seven tackles and had a fumble recovery in the win.

Kings Park 62, Amityville 0: John Flynn rushed for three touchdowns and caught another to lead Kings Park over Amityville in Suffolk III on Friday. Flynn rushed for 85 yards on eight carries and caught one pass for his 35-yard touchdown. Kyle Weeks rushed for 89 yards and two touchdowns on six carries and completed 4 of 5 passes for 58 yards and a touchdown. Weeks also had six tackles and a forced fumble for Kings Park (2-2). Dean Renna led the defense with 10 tackles and also scored a rushing touchdown. Kevin Greabell had an interception and Giuseppe Buffolino recovered a fumble. Amityville is 0-4.

Half Hollow Hills West 46, Kings Park 36: Joseph Filardi was 24 for 36 with 381 yards and five touchdowns to lead host Half Hollow Hills West (5-1) over Kings Park (2-3) in Suffolk III on Saturday. Filardi also rushed for 110 yards and one touchdown on 14 carries and had 11 tackles. Jesse Brooks had 149 receiving yards and three touchdowns on eight catches. Anthony Raio also had eight receptions, finishing with 104 yards and one touchdown. Luca Baggot had 10 tackles, and Nolan Doerrie had six tackles, two for a loss.   Kings Park's Kyle Weeks carried the ball 25 times for 269 yards with 3 Touchdowns and a 2 point conversion. Weeks was also 7 for 22 passing for 107 yards and had an interception on defense. John Flynn carried the ball 13 times for 72 yards and 2 touchdowns and a 2 point conversion.

Kings Park 37, East Hampton/Bridgehampton 6: Kyle Weeks threw for 175 yards and two touchdowns, and rushed for 50 yards and two touchdowns to lead Kings Park (3-3) in Suffolk III. Weeks also had 10 tackles and an interception. Kevin Greabell caught four passes for 78 yards and a touchdown, made seven tackles and recovered a fumble. Brandon Hauk and Tommy Cassar each had seven tackles and a sack, and Ryan Bubeck blocked a punt. Jai Feaster caught a touchdown pass from Jason Lester for East Hampton/Bridgehampton (2-5).

Westhampton 41, Kings Park 15: Nolan Michalowski rushed for 224 yards and a touchdown and added a receiving touchdown to lead Westhampton (5-2) in Suffolk III. William Gambino completed nine of 13 passes for 160 yards and three touchdowns, Riley Miller, Andrew Mensch and Aidan McDermott each had five tackles and McDermott added a sack and a blocked punt. Kyle Weeks rushed for 144 yards and a touchdown, and completed 19 passes for 231 yards and a passing touchdown for Kings Park (3-4).

Kings Park 56, Rocky Point 13: Kyle Weeks carried the ball seven times for 136 yards and four touchdowns for Kings Park against Rocky Point. Weeks completed seven of his 15 attempts for 84 yards and a touchdown. Weeks also had an interception on defense. John Flynn had 137 yards and a touchdown on 11 rushes. Flynn had two receptions for 25 yards and a touchdown. Flynn also had an interception on defense. Brandon Hauk had 10 tackles and Matt Munsinger had a 29-yard fumble return for a touchdown. Kings Park (4-4) scored 56 unanswered points. Jeremy Graham scored 20 and 74-yard rushing touchdowns for Rocky Point (1-7).

Sayville 35, Kings Park 14: Kyle Messina rushed for 170 yards and four touchdowns on 10 carries to lead No. 1 Sayville (9-0) over No. 8 Kings Park (4-5) in the Suffolk III quarterfinals at Greeley Ave. Messina also caught a 5-yard touchdown, made five tackles and had an interception. Jake Tripptree threw 12 for 16 and 219 yards, and Luke Hansen had six receptions and 146 yards. Jackson Neugebaurer had 10 tackles and two sacks. For Kings Park, Kyle Weeks rushed for 71 yards and a touchdown and was 10 for 24 passing with 158 yards. John Flynn rushed for 62 yards and a touchdown, had four receptions for 57 yards and made seven tackles. Brandon Hauk had 10 tackles, one sack, one interception and caught four passes for 88 yards. No. 1 Sayville will host the winner of No. 4 Half Hollow Hills West/No. 5 Smithtown West on Friday in the semifinals.
